summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). Built real-time robotics systems in C++ and Python — from two-link IK servo control on Arduino to TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at 18 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson; resolved 11 hardware-software integration failures to achieve 100% pick reliability, integrating VL53L0X ToF, ADXL345, and UART/I2C/SPI peripherals across ROS2 pipelines.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi Pico and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo crosstalk, rolling-shutter stereo depth); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
Built a vision-guided pick-and-place system on Jetson+Arduino: TensorRT YOLO visual servoing at ~18 FPS, dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Deployed YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson for real-time object tracking; sent control commands to STM32 over UART with interrupt-driven multi-servo PWM control.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed peripherals in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
